record.original_question: Let f : {-1,1}^n -> R_{>=0} satisfy E[f] = 1, and fix 0 < rho < 1. Must the upper tail of the noise operator obey Pr[T_rho f >= t] < o(1/t)?

evidence.quote: Statement: Let f : {-1, 1}^n -> R>=0 have E[ f ] = 1. Fix any 0 < rho < 1. Then Pr[T_rho f >= t] < o(1/ t).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n$ be a positive integer and equip $\{-1,1\}^n$ with the uniform probability measure. For $0<\rho<1$, the noise operator $T_\rho$ acts on functions $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$ by
$$(T_\rho f)(x) \;=\; \mathbb{E}\bigl[f(y)\bigr],$$
where $y\in\{-1,1\}^n$ is the random vector whose coordinates are independently equal to $x_i$ with probability $\tfrac{1+\rho}{2}$ and equal to $-x_i$ with probability $\tfrac{1-\rho}{2}$.

Fix $0<\rho<1$. Prove or disprove: for every nonnegative function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}_{\ge 0}$ with $\mathbb{E}[f]=1$, the tail of $T_\rho f$ satisfies
$$\Pr\bigl[\,T_\rho f \;\ge\; t\,\bigr] \;=\; o\!\left(\tfrac{1}{t}\right) \qquad \text{as } t\to\infty,$$
where the $o(1/t)$ rate is allowed to depend on $\rho$ but must be uniform in $n$ and in the choice of $f$ (i.e., a faster-than-Markov, dimension-free upper-tail estimate).
artifact.category_tag: Talagrand convolution conjecture / Boolean noise operator
artifact.status_search_result: The analogous Gaussian-space conjecture was resolved by Eldan and Lee (2015). On the Boolean hypercube, the conjecture remained open for years; a 2025 preprint by Yuansi Chen establishes the bound up to an additional dimension-free log log factor (i.e., the precise $o(1/t)$ form is not yet fully proved). The full discrete conjecture as stated thus remains not completely resolved.

status_evidence.title: Talagrand's convolution conjecture up to loglog via perturbed reverse heat
status_evidence.snippet: Proves the conjecture on the Boolean hypercube up to a dimension-free log log factor using a perturbed reverse heat process.
status_evidence.claim: Discrete Boolean version is partially solved (up to log log factor) as of 2025.

status_evidence.title: Talagrand's Convolution Conjecture on Gaussian Space (Eldan–Lee)
status_evidence.snippet: Eldan and Lee resolve the Gaussian-space form of the conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Gaussian analogue is solved; discrete case had remained open.

status_evidence.title: Talagrand's Convolution Conjecture · formal-conjectures issue
status_evidence.snippet: Lists Talagrand's convolution conjecture as an open conjecture for formalization.
status_evidence.claim: Conjecture is tracked as still open in the discrete setting.
